evals.name: create-task-list
evals.prompt: Create a task list for implementing user authentication feature
evals.expected_output: A docs/task/auth.yaml file with initial task structure and metadata

evals.name: execute-tasks
evals.prompt: Execute tasks from docs/task/auth.yaml automatically using the task manager script
evals.expected_output: Tasks executed in order with status updates (pending -> in_progress -> completed) and timestamps recorded

evals.name: convert-plan-to-tasks
evals.prompt: Convert docs/plan/2024-01-01-auth-plan.md to executable tasks in docs/task/
evals.expected_output: A docs/task/auth.yaml file with tasks derived from the plan, including dependencies between sequential tasks
